description:
Introducing the LullaBaby Swaddle Squad Affiliate Program: Wrap Up Some Cash While Helping Parents and Babies Sleep Better!

Are you an influential affiliate or influencer with a passion for helping new parents? We invite you to join the LullaBaby Swaddle Squad affiliate program and become a part of our mission to revolutionize sleep for families.

Here's why you should be excited to come on board:

Experience a world-class affiliate program that not only offers you an attractive commission structure but also provides comprehensive support to help you thrive. We offer training support, a group chat for affiliate community engagement, and weekly calls to discuss strategies and address concerns. Additionally, our monthly bonuses reward top-performing affiliates, further incentivizing your efforts.

Founded by a determined new mom and her supportive husband, LullaBaby is a brand born from the struggles of sleepless nights with a newborn. Our goal is to create innovative, high-quality baby products that provide a secure and comfortable sleep environment for both babies and parents. We're committed to making a difference in the lives of families everywhere.

LullaBaby Swaddle is our flagship product, designed to minimize the startle reflex and ensure restful sleep for babies. Featuring inner wings to keep baby's arms snug and outer wings that fasten with Velcro, this swaddle is made of soft, breathable 100% cotton. It also includes a two-way zipper for easy diaper changes. Our swaddle has helped countless parents say goodbye to sleepless nights and enjoy the rest they deserve.

LullaBaby has quickly gained momentum, with our swaddle receiving high ratings and rave reviews from our customers. Our success is a testament to the quality and effectiveness of our product. Now, we're inviting you to be part of this journey and earn cash by promoting a product you can truly believe in. Don't miss this opportunity to join our thriving affiliate program and share in our success.  

 
Join our team today!
 
Warm regards,
LullaBaby
term_and_condition:
Welcome to LullaBaby! Thanks for joining our Swaddle Squad Affiliate program ("Program").

These terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, the Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

Registration Approval or Rejection

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration at our sole discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for rejecting your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

Affiliate Links and Coupons

Affiliate links are automatically generated, but can also be generated for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliates might or might not be assigned a coupon code with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If a customer clicks on the affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may advertise the merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, and Instagram, or offline channels like magazines and newspapers.

 

Commissions and Payments

Affiliates earn commissions based on the Commission structure, dependent on order value, and not including extra fees (tax, shipping cost, etc.). To receive a commission, affiliates must specify their payment details in Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for successfully completed transactions. The Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, allowing the merchant to review each referral order. The status of commissions is displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions are listed in the Payment tab. Transactions resulting in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

 

Marketing Tools

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tools tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels.

 

Network

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. If any downline affiliate brings an order to the merchant shop, the upline affiliate will also receive a network commission, depending on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share the network link. Any other affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

 

Cookie Duration

Affiliates will receive commissions on sales generated through their unique affiliate links for a cookie duration of 30 days. This means that if a customer clicks on an affiliate's link and makes a purchase within the specified duration, the affiliate will earn a commission on that sale.

 

Self-referral and Promotion Restrictions

Affiliates are not allowed to earn commissions on their own purchases or sign-ups. Any attempts to do so may result in the termination of their affiliate account. Affiliates operating coupon or deal websites must receive written approval from our program before promoting our products or services. We reserve the right to decline or remove affiliates who do not comply with this requirement.

Affiliates are not allowed to bid on our brand name or any variations thereof for pay-per-click (PPC) advertising campaigns. Violation of this rule may result in immediate termination of the affiliate's account and forfeiture of any unpaid commissions.

 

Content and Promotion Guidelines

Affiliates must adhere to ethical and responsible marketing practices when promoting our products or services. This includes avoiding the use of misleading information, false claims, or spammy tactics. Affiliates must also ensure that their promotional materials comply with all applicable laws and regulations.

Affiliates are permitted to promote our products or services on social media platforms, provided they follow the platform's guidelines and do not engage in spammy or deceptive practices.

Affiliates must comply with the CAN-SPAM Act and any other applicable email marketing regulations when promoting our products or services via email. This includes obtaining the recipient's consent before sending promotional emails and providing an easy-to-use unsubscribe mechanism in each email.

 

Commission Reversals

We reserve the right to reverse commissions in cases of fraudulent or invalidated transactions, chargebacks, refunds, or any other situations deemed appropriate by the company.

 

Termination

We reserve the right to terminate an affiliate's account and withhold any unpaid commissions if they are found to be in violation of our program's terms and conditions.

 

Changes to the Program

We reserve the right to modify or update the affiliate program's terms and conditions at any time. Affiliates will be notified of any significant changes and will be responsible for staying informed about the program's latest terms.

 

Removal from the Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting hello@lullababyusa.com.

 

Commission Payout Timeline

Commissions will be paid out after a holding period of 30 days from the date of the transaction. This waiting period is implemented to account for any refunds, chargebacks, or other adjustments related to the referred transaction. Once the 30-day holding period has passed, commissions will be processed and paid according to the payment schedule specified on the Affiliate Guide page.

 

Thank you for joining our Swaddle Squad Affiliate Program! We wish you all the very best. You can always revisit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, you can email hello@lullababyusa.com for support.
